PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES
  THURSDAY, JUNE 6, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

Richard Lewis, Chair  Susana Gonzalez Edmond, Commissioner
Jane Templin, Vice Chair  Josh LaFarga, Commissioner
Alvaro Castillo, Commissioner  Michele Ware, Commissioner
Michael Clemson, Commissioner

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 5:01 PM, Chair Lewis called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Castillo, Clemson, LaFarga, Ware, Templin, Lewis

Commissioners Absent: Gonzalez Edmond

Also present: Vanessa Ibarra, Deputy City Attorney, Maryanne Cronin, Zoning Administration
Officer, Alex Medina, Bureau Secretary, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist.

Chair Lewis spoke; and announced that Commissioner Gonzalez Edmond was excused from the
meeting.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Commissioner Castillo led the Plegde of Allegiance.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-53669  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  A motion was made by Vice Chair Templin, seconded by Commissioner
  Clemson, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  6  Castillo, Clemson, LaFarga, Ware, Templin, Lewis
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Gonzalez Edmond

  Maryanne Cronin, Zoning Administration Officer, Community Development, spoke;
  and provided the Director’s Report.

  Page 1 of 4

2.  24-53670  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Planning Commission meeting of

  A motion was made by Vice Chair Templin, seconded by Commissioner

  Yes:  6  Castillo, Clemson, LaFarga, Ware, Templin, Lewis
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Gonzalez Edmond

3.  24-53671  Recommendation to accept Categorical Exemption CE-23-150 and approve a
  Conditional Use Permit (CUP23-025) and adopt the proposed findings and
  conditions of approval thereto, for a new-build wireless telecom site consisting of
  12 panel antennas with 6 Remote Radio Units (RRUs), and 1 microwave dish
  antenna mounted on an existing Southern California Edison high-tension electrical
  transmission tower, and a new ground-mounted equipment enclosure with ancillary
  equipment, located at 3628 Webster Avenue, immediately south of West Arlington
  Street, located in the PR (Public Right-of-Way) zoning district. (District 7)

  A motion was made by Commissioner Clemson, seconded by Vice Chair
  Templin, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  6  Castillo, Clemson, LaFarga, Ware, Templin, Lewis
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Gonzalez Edmond

  Maryanne Cronin, Zoning Administration Officer, Community Development, spoke.

  Refugio Torres Campos, Planner, Community Development, spoke; and provided a
  PowerPoint presentation.

  Chair Lewis spoke.

  Maryanne Cronin, Zoning Administration Officer, Community Development, spoke.

  Justin Robinson, a representative for the Applicant, spoke.

PUBLIC COMMENT
